st: Overcoming technological stagnation (if it exists) for a positive future

sec.p: Born in France in the mid-1800s, positivism is the cultural glue of technology. Dismissed as a short-sighted pursuit of the useful, lacking ethical/psychological analysis, it is undoubtedly the cultural foundation of the technological society we live in.

You can study technology with an evolutionary theory: just as a species evolves based on external pressures (or their absence), technological development goes hand in hand with society's acceptance/resistance.
